email='jes.mill@gmail.com'

# Intersection of liked songs with album library (20 songs)
intersection_song_ids=[1, 5, 6, 7, 16, 17, 18, 23, 25, 26, 27, 49, 52, 53, 63, 66, 76, 80, 81, 82]

# Existing review ids for my account needing update to rating 4
update_pairs=[(1,291),(25,293),(52,292)]

# Songs needing create (no existing review)
create_song_ids=[5, 6, 7, 16, 17, 18, 23, 26, 27, 49, 53, 63, 66, 76, 80, 81, 82]

results={'updates':[],'creates':[]}

# Update existing reviews
for sid,rid in update_pairs:
    res=apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=rid, access_token=token, rating=4)
    results['updates'].append({'song_id':sid,'review_id':rid,'res':res})

# Create reviews for remaining songs
for sid in create_song_ids:
    res=apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=sid, rating=4, access_token=token)
    results['creates'].append({'song_id':sid,'res':res})

print('update_result_count',len(results['updates']))
print('create_result_count',len(results['creates']))

# Verify final best rating per song for my user
final_best={}
for sid in intersection_song_ids:
    page_index=0
    all_reviews=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid,user_email=email,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
        page=res if isinstance(res,list) else res.get('reviews',[]) if isinstance(res,dict) else []
        if not page:
            break
        all_reviews.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    ratings=[r.get('rating') for r in all_reviews if r.get('rating') is not None]
    best=max([float(r) for r in ratings], default=None)
    final_best[sid]=best

wrong=[sid for sid in intersection_song_ids if final_best.get(sid)!=4.0 and final_best.get(sid)!=4]
print('wrong_count',len(wrong))
print('wrong_song_ids',wrong)
print('final_best_ratings',[(sid,final_best[sid]) for sid in intersection_song_ids])

# Completing the task in supervisor
res=apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=None)
print(res)
